body.statement: When \(\mathfrak O(T,C_j)=\varnothing\), the successful restriction transcript \(\tau_j\) has at most \(|T|\) strict restriction steps and admits an \(O(|T|^2)\)-bit representation apart from literal identifiers; each step is verifiable by graph traversal and value comparison.
body.justification: Polynomial local transcripts are required for an explicit certificate output rather than a black-box acceptance bit.
body.gap: The published algorithm terminates, but no acquisition-oriented transcript-size statement is given for value-labelled source restrictions.
body.consumer: A verifier can audit each selected source use and reconstruct the symbolic factor identification path.
